# Introduction

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/dashboard.webp"><img src="./assets/dashboard.webp" alt="Admin Panel" /></a>


The **WooCommerce Multi Vendor Marketplace plugin** is a powerful solution designed to transform a standard WooCommerce store into a fully functional multi-vendor marketplace.

With this plugin, you can allow **multiple independent vendors** to register, create their own shops, upload products, manage orders, and track earnings – all from a dedicated vendor dashboard.

This enables you to build marketplaces similar to:

- Amazon
- Flipkart
- Etsy
- eBay

---

## What does this plugin do?

This plugin converts your WooCommerce store into a **multi-seller platform** where:

- Each vendor gets a **separate profile page**
- Vendors can **add & manage products**
- Vendors can **process orders**
- Vendors can **track sales & transactions**
- Vendors can **communicate with admin**
- Admin has **full control over marketplace**

---

## Vendor Capabilities

Once registered, vendors get access to a **frontend dashboard** where they can:

- Add new products
- Edit existing products
- Delete products
- View product listings
- Track sales performance
- View transactions
- Manage orders
- Print invoices
- Update profile information
- Change passwords
- Ask questions to admin

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/general-settings.webp"><img src="./assets/general-settings.webp" alt="Admin Panel" /></a>

---

## Admin Capabilities

Marketplace owners (admins) can:

- Manage vendor list
- Manage product list
- Approve or disapprove vendors
- Approve or disapprove vendor products
- Assign products to vendors
- Set **different commission rates** for each vendor
- Enable or disable **auto vendor approval**
- Enable or disable **auto product publish**
- Control all marketplace settings

---

## Theme Compatibility

> ⚠ This module is fully compatible with **all standard WooCommerce themes**.

# Features

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/key-features.webp"><img src="./assets/key-features.webp" alt="Key Features" /></a>


The WooCommerce Multi Vendor Marketplace plugin offers a **robust, scalable, and enterprise-ready feature set** that empowers both marketplace owners and vendors. It is designed to handle high traffic, multiple sellers, and complex order workflows with ease.

---

## Core Marketplace Features

### 1. Multi-Vendor Registration
Allow unlimited vendors to register on your platform. Vendors can sign up using the default WooCommerce registration form or a dedicated Seller Central onboarding page. This helps you easily onboard new sellers without manual intervention.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/sellercentral.webp"><img src="./assets/sellercentral.webp" alt="Seller Central" /></a>

---

### 2. Separate Vendor Profile Pages
Each vendor gets a **dedicated shop page** containing:
- Shop logo
- Banner image
- About section
- Product collection
- Reviews & ratings

This helps vendors build their own brand identity within your marketplace.

---

### 3. Vendor Shipping Management
Vendors can configure their own shipping:
- Create shipping zones
- Add shipping methods
- Define shipping costs
- Manage shipping classes

This allows vendors to control logistics independently.

---

### 4. Featured Products
Admins can mark specific vendor products as **featured** to:
- Increase product visibility
- Boost sales
- Highlight trending products

---

### 5. Admin-like Vendor Dashboard
Admins can enable an **advanced dashboard view** for vendors that resembles the WordPress admin panel. Vendors can switch between:
- Frontend dashboard (simple)
- Admin-style dashboard (advanced)

This provides flexibility for both beginner and power sellers.

---

### 6. Vendor Query System
Vendors can submit queries to admins directly from their dashboard. Admins can:
- Reply to queries
- Track conversations
- Maintain a history of communication

This ensures smooth communication and support.

---

### 7. Vendor Profile Management
Vendors can manage:
- Personal details
- Shop information
- Social media links
- Return, shipping & privacy policies

This improves transparency and customer trust.

---

### 8. Advanced Product Management
Vendors can create multiple product types:

- Simple
- Grouped
- External/Affiliate
- Variable
- Downloadable

They can manage:
- Pricing
- Inventory
- Images
- Attributes
- Variations

Admins also retain control to edit or remove any product.

---

### 9. Order Management
Vendors can:
- View order details
- Access billing & shipping info
- Update order status
- Print invoices
- Upload custom invoices

This ensures professional order handling.

---

### 10. Vendor Approval System
Admins have full control over:
- Approving new vendors
- Approving vendor products
- Blocking suspicious sellers

This protects marketplace quality.

---

### 11. Product Assignment & Transfer
Admins can:
- Assign products to vendors
- Transfer products between vendors
- Reassign ownership if required

Useful for vendor migration and management.

---

### 12. SEO-Friendly URLs
Vendor profiles and product pages use **clean URLs**, improving:
- Google ranking
- Click-through rate
- Search visibility

---

### 13. Flexible Commission System
Admins can configure:
- Global commission
- Vendor-specific commission
- Fixed commission
- Percentage commission
- Hybrid (fixed + percentage)

This allows complete revenue control.

---

### 14. Favorite Vendors & Shop Followers
Customers can:
- Follow vendors
- Receive updates
- Get notified about new products

This increases repeat sales.

---

### 15. Bulk Product Assignment
Admins can:
- Assign multiple products to vendors in bulk
- Save time on large catalogs

---

### 16. Upsell & Cross-Sell Products
Vendors can:
- Suggest premium alternatives
- Promote related products
- Increase average order value

---

### 17. WordPress Multisite Support
Fully compatible with:
- Multisite networks
- Centralized management
- Multiple stores

---

### 18. HPOS Compatibility
Optimized for:
- WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage
- Faster order processing
- Large-scale stores

---

### 19. WooCommerce Blocks Support
Compatible with:
- Cart block
- Checkout block
- Latest WooCommerce UI

---

## Advanced Marketplace Features

### 20. Vendor Transactions
Admins can:
- Transfer vendor earnings

Vendors can:
- View transaction history

### 21. Vendor-wise Category Control

---

- Initiate refunds

---

### 27. Product Approval Notifications
Admins get real-time alerts when:
- Vendors add products
- Vendors edit products

---

### 28. Google Analytics Integration
Admins can:
- Track sales

- Analyze customer behavior

---

### 29. WPML Multilingual Support
Supports:
- Multi-language marketplaces
- Vendor product translation
- Global audience

---

### 30. Google Map Integration
Displays:
- Top billing countries

- Location insights

---

### 31. Enhanced Vendor Profiles
Includes:
- TinyMCE editor

- Custom slugs

---

### 32. GA4 Event Tracking
Tracks:
- Product views
- Purchases

---

### 33. Global Attributes Access
Vendors can:
- Use admin-created attributes
- Create attribute terms
- Manage variations easily

---

## Latest Enterprise Features

### 34. Seller Central Onboarding
Admins can:
- Design onboarding page

---

### 35. Vendor Invoice Upload
Vendors can:

- Stock status

Displayed on profile pages.

Automatic emails sent when:
- Product stock is low

---

### 39. Dashboard Theme Colors
Admins can:
- Customize graph colors
- Match brand identity

---

### 40. Coupon Cost Sharing
Admins decide:
- Who bears discount
- Vendor
- Admin
- Both

---

### 41. Product Fulfilment Badge
Vendors can display:
- Fulfilment label
- Delivery branding

---

### 42. Vendor News System
Admins can:
- Publish announcements
- Send updates to vendors

---

### 43. Order Filter Grids
Vendors can filter orders by:
- Completed
- Pending
- Refunded

---

### 44. Vendor & Product Reporting
Customers can:
- Report vendors
- Flag products

Admins can:
- Review complaints
- Take action

---

### 45. Vendor Order Emails
Custom vendor emails:
- New order
- Status updates
- Branding support

---

### 46. Hybrid Commission Model
Supports:
- Fixed fee
- Percentage fee
- Combined model

---

### 47. Customer to Vendor Conversion
Admins can:
- Convert customers into vendors
- Reduce onboarding friction

---

### 48. Global Attributes Access
Vendors can:
- Use marketplace attributes
- Maintain consistency

---

### 49. Custom Shipping Email Titles
Admins can:
- Customize shipping emails
- Improve branding

---

### 50. Customer Privacy Controls
Admins can:
- Hide customer details
- Improve data security

---

### 51. Vendor Purchase Restriction
Prevents:
- Vendors buying their own products
- Fake orders & reviews

---

### 52. Product Tags & Brands
Vendors can:

## Tax Handling

> ⚠ For all orders (including vendor orders),
**Tax amount is credited to admin account.**

It is perfect for:

# Installation

This guide explains how to properly install and activate the **WooCommerce Multi Vendor Marketplace plugin** on your WordPress website.

Follow each step carefully to ensure a smooth setup.

---

## System Requirements

Before installation, make sure:

| Requirement        | Minimum / Recommended Version |
|--------------------|--------------------------------|
| WordPress Version  | 6.7 or higher                  |
| WooCommerce Version| 10.0 or higher                 |
| PHP Version        | 7.4+ (recommended)             |
| Memory Limit       | 256MB or higher                |
| SSL                | Enabled (recommended)          |


---

## Step 1 – Download Plugin

After purchase, you will receive a **ZIP file** of the plugin.

Do NOT unzip the file before uploading.

---

## Step 2 – Upload Plugin

1. Login to your **WordPress Admin Panel**
2. Navigate to: **Plugins > Add New**


3. Click **Upload Plugin** (top of page)
4. Click **Choose File**
5. Select the downloaded ZIP file

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/upload-plugin.webp"><img src="./assets/upload-plugin.webp" alt="Upload Plugin" /></a>

---

## Step 3 – Install Plugin

Click the **Install Now** button.

WordPress will upload and install the plugin automatically.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/install-now.webp"><img src="./assets/install-now.webp" alt="Install Plugin" /></a>

---

## Step 4 – Activate Plugin

Once installed:

- You will see **Plugin installed successfully**
- Click **Activate Plugin**

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/activate-plugin.webp"><img src="./assets/activate-plugin.webp" alt="Activate Plugin" /></a>

---

## Step 5 – Activate License

- To activate the license, go to **Marketplace > Settings**
- The wizard will be show to activate the license.
- Enter the **License Key** and click **Activate License**

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/license-wizard.webp"><img src="./assets/license-wizard.webp" alt="Activate License" /></a>

- **[License Activation Guide](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/license-validator/)** – Step-by-step instructions on activating your plugin license.

---

## Step 6 – Marketplace Menu

After activation:

- A new **Marketplace** menu appears in the admin sidebar

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/general-settings.webp"><img src="./assets/general-settings.webp" alt="Marketplace Menu" /></a>

---

## Step 7 – Update Permalinks

This step is **mandatory**.

   - Go to **Settings > Permalinks**.
   - Set **Post Name** as the permalink structure.
   <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/flush-permalink.webp"><img src="./assets/flush-permalink.webp" alt="Update Permalinks" /></a>

## Notes

- Always ensure the plugin zip is compatible with your WooCommerce version.
- Update permalinks after installation to avoid 404 errors.

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/elementor-shortcodes.html -->

# Elementor Compatibility and Shortcodes

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/elementor-compatibility.webp"><img src="./assets/elementor-compatibility.webp" alt="Elementor compatibility" /></a>

WooCommerce Marketplace is fully **compatible with Elementor**, enabling admins to easily design vendor-related pages using shortcodes.

---

## Vendor Registration and Login Page

The admin can create a vendor registration and login page using **Elementor’s Shortcode widget**.

### How to Create the Vendor Page

1. Edit a page using **Elementor**.
2. Drag and drop the **Shortcode** widget onto the page.
3. Insert the following shortcode:

```text
[marketplace]
```

## Display Vendor Name on Single Product Page

To display the vendor’s name on the single product page, use the following shortcode:

```text
[wkmp_seller_profile_link]
```

### This Shortcode Displays

- Vendor registration form

- Vendor login form

### After Login, Vendors Can

- View their profile details

- Manage their account information from the same page

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/woocommerce-marketplace-seller-elementor.webp"><img src="./assets/woocommerce-marketplace-seller-elementor.webp" alt="Vendor Page using Elementor" /></a>
<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/woocommerce-marketplace-seller-edit-elementor.webp"><img src="./assets/woocommerce-marketplace-seller-edit-elementor.webp" alt="Vendor Profile Page" /></a>
### Display Vendor Name on Single Product Page

To show the vendor’s name on the single product page, use the shortcode below:

```text
[wkmp_seller_profile_link]
```

### Functionality

- Displays the vendor name on the product page

- Vendor name appears as a clickable link

- Redirects customers to the vendor’s profile page

### How to Use

- Edit the Single Product Page using Elementor

- Add a Shortcode widget where the vendor name should appear

- Paste the shortcode:

```text
[wkmp_seller_profile_link]
```

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/shortcode1.webp"><img src="./assets/shortcode1.webp" alt="Vendor Name on Product Page" /></a>
### Display Vendor List with Search & Product Count

To display a list of all vendors with search and product count, use the shortcode below:

```text
[wkmp-vendors-list show_search=yes show_heading=1 show_product_count=1]
```

### Displayed Features

- List of all registered vendors

- Search bar to filter vendors

- Section heading

- Product count for each vendor

### Shortcode Parameters Table
| Parameter              | Value | Description              |
|------------------------|-------|--------------------------|
| `show_search`          | yes   | Show vendor search bar   |
| `show_search`          | no    | Hide vendor search bar   |
| `show_heading`         | 1     | Show heading             |
| `show_heading`         | 0     | Hide heading             |
| `show_product_count`   | 1     | Show product count       |
| `show_product_count`   | 0     | Hide product count       |

### How to Use

- Edit any page using Elementor or the WordPress editor

- Add a Shortcode widget or block

- Paste the shortcode:

```text
[wkmp-vendors-list show_search=yes show_heading=1 show_product_count=1]
```
<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-list-shortcode-and-count.webp"><img src="./assets/vendor-list-shortcode-and-count.webp" alt="Vendor List Page" /></a>

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/configuration-general-settings.html -->

# Configuration – General Settings

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/general-settings.png"><img src="./assets/general-settings.png" alt="Admin Panel" /></a>

After successfully installing WooCommerce Marketplace, the admin can configure the core marketplace settings such as vendor registration, approval workflow, default vendor capabilities, and overall marketplace behavior from:

**Marketplace > Settings > General**

---

## General Settings Options

### Default Commission

The **Default Commission** is applied when no commission is set specifically for a vendor.
Admins can set a combination of a fixed flat amount and a percentage (e.g., `$0 + 15%`).

#### Example

- Product Price: **$100**

If the default commission is **20%**:
- Vendor receives: **$80**
- Admin commission: **$20**

---

### Deduct Discount From

If a discount is applied by the customer, this option defines how the discount amount is adjusted.

Available options:

- Both vendor total amount and admin commission amount
- Vendor total amount only
- Admin commission amount only

*Note: If selected from the 'Admin Commission Amount' and the discount amount is more than the commission amount then the difference will also be borne by the admin.*

---

### Auto Approve Vendor

If enabled, vendors will be **automatically approved** after registration.

#### Example

- When enabled, any user signing up as a vendor is instantly converted into a vendor.
- When disabled, admin approval is required before the user becomes a vendor.

---

### Separate Vendor Dashboard

If enabled, vendors will have a **separate dashboard**, similar to the admin dashboard, for managing their marketplace activities.

---

### Data Delete After Vendor Delete

- If enabled, **all vendor data** will be deleted when the vendor is removed.
- If disabled, the vendor’s data will be **assigned to the admin** instead.

---

### Applicable Shipping Methods

The admin can select which shipping method will apply at checkout:

- **Admin Shipping Method**
- **Vendor Shipping Method**

---

#### More About Applicable Shipping Methods

##### Admin Shipping Method Selected

- Admin shipping rates will apply to **all products**, including vendor products.
- The shipping rate remains the same regardless of whether the cart contains admin or vendor products.

##### Vendor Shipping Method Selected

- Vendor-specific shipping rates will apply to vendor products.
- Admin shipping applies to admin products.

##### Mixed Cart (Admin + Vendor Products)

If the cart contains products from **both admin and vendor**:

- The total shipping cost will be a **combined rate** of both admin and vendor shipping.
- This applies regardless of the selected Applicable Shipping Method.

---

### Vendor Page

Select the page to be used as the **Vendor Page** (which shows the vendor listing).

⚠️ **Important Notes**:
- Updating the vendor page will **erase existing content** of the newly selected page.
- After changing the page, kindly **update permalinks**.

---

### Seller Central Page

Select the page to be used as the **Seller Central Page**.

⚠️ **Important Notes**:
- Updating a new seller central page will **erase existing content** of the newly selected page.
- After changing the page, kindly **update permalinks**.

---

### Shop Name on Registration

- If set to **Required**, vendors must enter a **Shop Name** during registration.
- If set to **Optional** and left empty, the module will use the **Vendor Name** as the shop name.

---

### Shop Slug on Registration

- If set to **Required**, vendors must enter a **Shop URL** during registration.
- If set to **Optional** and left empty, the module will use the **Shop Slug** as the vendor’s username.

---

### Vendor Terms & Conditions Page

The admin can select a **Terms & Conditions page** that will be displayed to vendors during registration.

---

### Allow Vendor Registration on My Account

- If enabled, vendor registration fields will appear on the **WooCommerce My Account** signup form.
- If disabled, a link to the **Seller Central Registration Form** will be displayed instead.

---

### Vendor KYC Verification Settings

Admins can configure the KYC settings directly from the General tab:
- **Enable Vendor KYC Verification**: A master toggle to enable or disable the feature globally.
- **KYC Document Types**: Admins can define the types of documents allowed (e.g., Business License, Government ID, Utility Bill).
- **Allowed KYC Formats**: Restrict document uploads to specific formats (PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP).
- **Restrict KYC Document Size**: Optionally define minimum and maximum file size limits (in KB) for the document uploads.

---

### Admin-configurable Upload Restrictions

Admins can set global upload restrictions for every vendor image, including:
- Avatar
- Logo
- Fulfillment
- Banner

For each image type, admins can define:
- Allowed file types
- Optional file size limits
- Optional dimension limits (width/height)

<!-- <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/placeholder-upload-restrictions.png"><img src="./assets/placeholder-upload-restrictions.png" alt="Upload Restrictions" /></a> -->

---

### "Sold by" Visibility Control

Admins have full control over whether the "Sold by" text is visible to customers.
- **Global Setting**: A master toggle to hide the vendor name and store links across the shop, cart, checkout, orders, emails, and invoices.
- **Per-Vendor Override**: Admins can override the global setting on a per-vendor basis if certain vendors need their names displayed or hidden.

<!-- <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/placeholder-sold-by-visibility.png"><img src="./assets/placeholder-sold-by-visibility.png" alt="Sold By Visibility Settings" /></a> -->

---

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/product-settings.html -->

# Configuration – Product Settings

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/product-settings.webp"><img src="./assets/product-settings.webp" alt="Product Settings" /></a>
<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/fulfillment.webp"><img src="./assets/fulfillment.webp" alt="Product Settings" /></a>


The **Product Settings** allow the admin to manage how vendors add, edit, and publish products in the marketplace.

**Path:**
Marketplace > Settings > Product

---

### Vendor product settings

- **Allow Vendor to Publish**
  - Enable to auto-approve and publish vendor products.
  - Disable to require admin approval for all vendor-added or edited products.
  - *Flow:* Vendor adds/edits product → Status becomes **Draft** → Admin reviews and publishes.

- **Allow Vendors to Translate Products (WPML)**
  - Enables vendors to translate products from their dashboard.
  - Available only when **WPML** is installed and activated.

- **Allowed Product Types**
  - Admin selects which product types vendors can create.
  - Examples:
    - Simple
    - Variable
    - Grouped
    - External
    - Downloadable

- **Allowed Categories**
  - Admin selects which product categories vendors can use while adding products.

- **Minimum Order Amount Setting**
  - Enable to enforce a minimum purchase amount for vendor products.
  - Admin can define a default minimum value.
  - If **Amount Value for Vendor** is enabled and vendor leaves it empty, the admin value is applied.

- **Product Quantity Limit Setting**
  - Enable to allow vendors to set maximum purchase quantity.
  - Admin can define a global default maximum quantity for vendor products.

---

## Product Fulfilment Settings

- When enabled, vendors can manage their own product fulfilment details.
- Vendors can add a fulfilment label, image, and description from their dashboard.
- Vendor-specific fulfilment information is displayed on the product page.
- When disabled, fulfilment details are managed and shown only by the admin.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/fulfillment.webp"><img src="./assets/fulfillment.webp" alt="Product Settings" /></a>


- Allows buyers to see **who will fulfil product delivery**.
- **Admin can:**
  - Enable fulfilment for marketplace vendors
  - Upload a fulfilment image
  - Add fulfilment label and descriptive text
- **Vendor Support:**
  - Vendors can configure fulfilment details from their dashboard.
  - Vendor-specific fulfilment details appear on the product page.

---

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/assets-visibility.html -->

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/asset-visibility.webp"><img src="./assets/asset-visibility.webp" alt="Seller Central Banner" /></a>

The **Assets Visibility** settings allow the admin to control which vendor details and assets are visible on the **Vendor Profile** and **Vendor Dashboard**.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/assets-visibility.webp"><img src="./assets/assets-visibility.webp" alt="Seller Central Banner" /></a>


- **Email**
  - Show or hide the vendor’s email address on the vendor profile

- **Phone Number**
  - Enable or disable the display of the vendor’s phone number

- **Address**
  - Control whether the vendor’s address is visible on the profile page

- **Social Links**
  - Show or hide vendor social media links on the vendor profile

- **Hide Customer Details From Vendor**
  - Restricts vendors from viewing customer billing details
  - Restricts vendors from viewing customer shipping details
  - Helps maintain customer privacy

- **Show Legacy Vendor Profile**
  - Enable to display the vendor profile using the legacy layout
  - Disable to use the new optimized layout
    - Includes Report Flag section
    - Improved UI and performance

  <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/show-lagecy-vendor.webp"><img src="./assets/show-lagecy-vendor.webp" alt="show legacy vendor profile" /></a>

  - Defines the primary color used in vendor dashboard statistics

- **Secondary Color Code**
  - Defines the secondary color used in vendor dashboard statistics

# Configuration – Endpoints

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/endpoints.webp"><img src="./assets/endpoints.webp" alt="Endpoints" /></a>

The **Endpoints** configuration allows the admin to manage dynamic URL segments used across the vendor dashboard and related pages in the WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace.

---

## Endpoints Overview

- Endpoints add an extra segment to a page URL
- Used to load different sections without creating separate pages
- Commonly used for:
  - Vendor dashboard pages
  - Vendor profile pages
  - Orders, settings, and other vendor actions
- Fully configurable by the admin

---

## What is an Endpoint?

- An endpoint is an additional URL segment appended to a page
- Example:
  - Base URL: `example.com/vendorprofile`
  - With endpoint: `example.com/vendorprofile/edit-vendor-profile`
- Helps display specific sections such as:
  - Edit Profile
  - Dashboard
  - Order History
  - Settings pages

---

## Admin Configuration

- Navigate to:
  - **Marketplace > Settings > Endpoints**
- The admin can configure:
  - **Endpoint** – URL slug appended to the page
  - **Title** – Menu label shown in the vendor dashboard

---

## Endpoint Customization

- Each endpoint URL can be customized
- Endpoints must be **unique** to avoid conflicts
- Any changes reflect immediately in vendor dashboard URLs
- **Hide Dashboard Sections**: Admins can easily hide individual vendor dashboard sections directly from the Endpoints settings by disabling their respective endpoints.
- Recommended practice:
  - Use a prefix such as **`vendor-`** to avoid collisions

---

## Examples

- **Dashboard**
  - Endpoint: `dashboard`
  - Title: `Dashboard`

- **Order History**
  - Endpoint: `order-history`
  - Title: `Order History`

---

## Vendor Dashboard Menu

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/dashboard.webp"><img src="./assets/dashboard.webp" alt="Vendor Dashboard Endpoints" /></a>

- Endpoint **Titles** appear as menu items in the vendor dashboard
- Clicking a menu item loads the corresponding page using its endpoint

---

## Hide Customer WooCommerce Endpoints

- Admin can hide **customer-related WooCommerce endpoints** from the vendor dashboard
- Prevents vendors from seeing irrelevant customer menu items
- Improves vendor dashboard clarity and usability

### Already Registered WooCommerce Endpoints

- `dashboard`
- `orders`
- `downloads`
- `edit-address`
- `payment-methods`
- `edit-account`
- `customer-logout`
- `order-pay`
- `order-received`
- `view-order`
- `lost-password`
- `add-payment-method`
- `delete-payment-method`
- `set-default-payment-method`

### Behavior

- These customer endpoints can be hidden across **all vendor endpoint pages**
- Only vendor-relevant endpoints remain visible in the dashboard
- **Re-show Logout Endpoint**: If customer endpoints are hidden, admins can use a specific option to keep the **Logout** endpoint visible, ensuring vendors can still log out easily.

---

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/configuration-google-analytics.html -->

# Configuration – Google Analytics

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/google-analytics-map.webp"><img src="./assets/google-analytics-map.webp" alt="Google Analytics and Map" /></a>


The **Google Analytics** feature allows the admin and vendors to track website and product performance using Google Analytics (GA-4).

---

## Google Analytics Overview

- Helps analyze customer behavior and store performance
- Tracks product views, purchases, and sales data
- Supports real-time analytics and debug mode

---

## Google Analytics Settings

### Enable Google Analytics

- Enable to populate Google Analytics data on the marketplace

---

### Measurement ID

- Enter the Google Analytics **GA-4 Measurement ID**
- Can be obtained from the Google Analytics account
- [Click here to learn how to get the Measurement ID](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/documentation/google-analytics.md)


### Allow Vendor to Use Google Analytics

- Enables vendors to connect and use their own GA account
- Vendors can track their individual store performance

---

### Enable Tracking Events

- Enable required tracking events:
  - View Item Event
  - Purchase Event

---

### Enable Debug Mode

- Enables real-time event tracking
- Allows admin and vendors to:
  - Verify events instantly
  - View data in GA-4 Debug View

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/gc-4-debug.webp"><img src="./assets/gc-4-debug.webp" alt="GA-4 Debug Mode" /></a>

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/gc-4-debug-b.webp"><img src="./assets/gc-4-debug-b.webp" alt="Real-Time Purchase Data" /></a>

---

## Google Map API

- Admin can add the Google Map API key
- API key must be generated from the Google Cloud Console

---

## Supported Analytics Data

### Product Performance

- Product revenue
- Unique purchases
- Quantity sold
- Average price
- Average quantity

### Sales Performance

- Transaction ID
- Revenue
- Tax
- Shipping cost

# Configuration – Withdrawal

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/withdrawal-settings.webp"><img src="./assets/withdrawal-settings.webp" alt="Admin Withdrawal Settings" /></a>

The **Withdrawal** feature allows vendors to withdraw their earnings using configured payment methods.

The admin can configure this from:

**Marketplace > Settings > Withdrawal**

---

## Withdrawal Overview

- Enables vendors to withdraw their available balance
- Supports both manual and automatic withdrawal methods
- Admin can define limits, charges, and payment methods

---

## Withdrawal Settings

### Enable Withdrawal

- Toggle to enable or disable the withdrawal functionality for vendors

---

### Withdrawal Limit

- Minimum balance required to create a withdrawal request
- **Note:** This limit does not apply to automatic withdrawals

---

### Withdrawal Type

- Choose how withdrawals are processed:

#### Manual
- Vendors manually create withdrawal requests
- Vendors can:
  - Select eligible completed orders
  - Update withdrawal payment method
  - View applicable charges
  - See the final withdrawable amount before submitting

#### Automatic
- Withdrawal requests are auto-generated:
  - For all active vendors
  - On the last date of every month
- Vendors must select a default payment method
- Withdrawal charges (if any) are applied automatically

---

### Withdrawal Method

- Enable or disable available withdrawal payment methods

---

### Withdrawal Charges

- Define charges for each withdrawal method as required

---

## Save Configuration

- Click **Save** to apply the withdrawal settings

---

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/configuration-vendor-invoice.html -->

# Configuration – Vendor Invoice

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-invoice.webp"><img src="./assets/vendor-invoice.webp" alt="Vendor Invoice" /></a>

The **Vendor Invoice** feature allows vendors to generate and share invoices for their orders, ensuring transparency between vendors, admin, and customers.

The admin can configure this section from:

**Marketplace > Settings > Vendor Invoice**

---

## Vendor Invoice Overview

- Allows vendors to generate invoices for their orders
- Helps maintain transparency in vendor earnings
- Invoices can be shared with customers as proof of purchase
- Both admin and vendors can send invoices to customers


---

## Invoice Details Included

A vendor invoice contains the following information:

- Product price
- Vendor commission
- Shipping charges
- Applicable taxes
- Final vendor earnings

---

## Vendor Invoice Settings

### Allow for the Vendor

- Enables vendors to generate and access invoices
- Invoices are available from the vendor dashboard

---

### Attach in the Mail

- Automatically attaches the invoice to order confirmation emails
- Ensures customers receive invoices without manual effort

---

### Allow File Types

- Defines the supported file formats for invoice uploads
- Common supported formats include:
  - PDF
  - JPG
  - webp

---

### Allow File Size

- Sets the maximum allowed file size for invoice attachments
- Helps manage storage and performance efficiently

---

## Save Configuration

- After configuring the invoice settings, click **Save**
- Changes will apply immediately

## Seller Central Overview

- **Page Selectors**: Admins can easily select the Seller Central page. The selectors for Vendor, Seller Central, and Terms & Conditions pages are now **searchable**, making it easy to find the right page.

## Reviews Section

## Workflow Section

- Makes vendor onboarding simple and clear
- Helps reduce confusion during registration

## Benefits Section

# Vendor Registration Process
<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/Registration.webp"><img src="./assets/Registration.webp" alt="Vendor Registration" /></a>

Vendors can register on the marketplace using multiple methods provided by the WooCommerce Marketplace plugin.

---

## Method 1: Registration via Vendor Menu

- Vendor clicks on the **Vendor** menu item.
- The page displays two options:
  - **Login Here**
  - **Register**

  <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-login.webp"><img src="./assets/seller-login.webp" alt="Vendor Menu" /></a>

- Clicking **Login Here** redirects to the vendor login page.
- Clicking **Register** redirects to the vendor registration page.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-menu.webp"><img src="./assets/vendor-menu.webp" alt="Vendor Menu" /></a>

---

## Method 2: Registration via Seller Central Page

- Vendor visits the **Seller Central** page.
- Clicks on the **Become a Seller** button.


<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/sellercentral.webp"><img src="./assets/sellercentral.webp" alt="Seller Central" /></a>

- The vendor registration form opens.
- Vendor completes and submits the registration form.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/sellercentral-registration-form.webp"><img src="./assets/sellercentral-registration-form.webp" alt="Seller Central Registration Form" /></a>

---

## Method 3: Registration via My Account Page

If the admin enables **Allow Vendor Registration on My Account**:

- A **vendor registration option** is available on the **My Account** sign-up page.
- The user selects the **“I am a Vendor”** radio button during registration.
- Additional **vendor-specific registration fields** are displayed automatically.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-registration-page.webp"><img src="./assets/seller-registration-page.webp" alt="Seller Registration Page" /></a>

---

## Vendor Registration Form Fields

The vendor must enter the following details:

- Email Address
- Password
- First Name
- Last Name
- Shop Name
- Shop URL
- Phone Number
- Accept Terms & Conditions

After entering the details, click the **Register** button.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/registration-details.webp"><img src="./assets/registration-details.webp" alt="Registration Details" /></a>

---

## Shop URL Availability Check

- The **Shop URL** field uses an **AJAX-based availability check**.
- Displays **“Available”** if the URL is unused.
- Displays **“Already Exists”** if the URL already exists.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/registration-details.webp"><img src="./assets/registration-details.webp" alt="Shop URL Availability" /></a>

---

## Registration Using Email & Password

- Vendor registration is completed using **email and password**.
- Vendor access is granted based on admin approval settings.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/register-as-vendor.webp"><img src="./assets/register-as-vendor.webp" alt="Register as Vendor" /></a>

---

## Become a Vendor from Customer Account

- Existing customers can upgrade to a vendor account.
- A **Become a Vendor** option is available in the **My Account** panel.
- Clicking it initiates the vendor registration process.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-account-become-vendor.webp"><img src="./assets/customer-account-become-vendor.webp" alt="Become Vendor from Account" /></a>

---

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/admin-news.html -->

# Admin News

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/all-news.webp"><img src="./assets/all-news.webp" alt="All News List" /></a>

The **Admin News** feature allows the admin to create and publish news updates for vendors.
Admins can also control the **visibility of news for sellers** based on marketplace requirements.

---

## Access Path

- **Marketplace → Admin News**

---

## Create News

- Click on **Add New News** to create a new announcement.
- Enter the required news details such as:
  - News title
  - Description/content
  - Visibility options

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/settings.webp"><img src="./assets/settings.webp" alt="Admin News Settings" /></a>

- Click **Publish** to make the news live.
- Admin can also **edit previously published news** at any time.

<!-- <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-edit-news.webp"><img src="./assets/admin-edit-news.webp" alt="Add New News" /></a> -->

---

## News Visibility Options

While creating or editing news, the admin can control which sellers can see the announcement using the following options:

### Show News to Sellers

- When this option is enabled:
  - The news is visible to **all sellers** in the marketplace.
  - Sellers can view the news from their **Vendor Account Panel**.
- Suitable for:
  - General marketplace announcements
  - Policy updates
  - Feature releases
  - Maintenance notifications

---

### Hide News from Sellers

- When this option is enabled:
  - The news is **hidden from sellers**.
  - Only the admin can view the news in the admin panel.
- Useful for:
  - Draft announcements
  - Internal testing
  - Temporarily disabling outdated or irrelevant news
  - Preparing announcements for future publishing

> **Note:** The admin can toggle these options anytime by editing the news item.

---

## View All News

- Click on **See All News** to view the complete list of created news.
- Displays:
  - Active news
  - Hidden news
  - Previously published announcements

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/all-news.webp"><img src="./assets/all-news.webp" alt="All News List" /></a>

---

## Vendor Visibility

- Published and visible news appears in the vendor’s **Vendor Account Panel**.
- Sellers can:
  - View the announcement title
  - Read the full news content

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-new.webp"><img src="./assets/vendor-new.webp" alt="Vendor News View" /></a>

---

## Use Cases

- Marketplace-wide announcements
- Vendor onboarding updates
- Policy or commission changes
- New feature releases
- Scheduled maintenance notifications

---

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-mangement.html -->

# Vendor Management

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-profile-badge-display.webp"><img src="./assets/vendor-profile-badge-display.webp" alt="Vendor Badges Frontend View" /></a>

The **Vendor Badges** feature allows marketplace admins to recognize, reward, and showcase vendor performance. Badges act as trust indicators and are displayed on vendor profile pages to improve buyer confidence.


---

## Admin Badge Management

Admins can manage all vendor badges from the marketplace admin panel.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/badges-settings.webp"><img src="./assets/badges-settings.webp" alt="Badges Settings" /></a>

*(Marketplace → Badges section)*

- Create unlimited custom vendor badges
- Control badge visibility using status (Enabled/Disabled)
- Assign priority using badge ranking
- Upload custom badge images for visual recognition

---

## Add New Badge

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/add-badge.webp"><img src="./assets/add-badge.webp" alt="Add New Badges" /></a>


Admins can create a new badge by filling in the following fields:

- **Badge Name**
  - Alphanumeric name (e.g., Gold, Silver, Platinum)
- **Badge Description**
  - Short explanation of eligibility
  - Example: *For 10,000 sales and above*
- **Rank**
  - Determines badge priority when multiple badges exist
- **Status**
  - Enable or disable the badge instantly
- **Badge Image**
  - Upload a custom badge icon

This allows full control over how badges appear and function in the marketplace.

---

## Update Existing Badge

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/update-badge.webp"><img src="./assets/update-badge.webp" alt="Edit Badges" /></a>


Admins can update badge details at any time:

- Edit badge name or description
- Change badge rank
- Replace badge image
- Enable or disable the badge without deleting it

This ensures badge criteria remain relevant as the marketplace evolves.

---

## Assign Badge to Vendor

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-details-badge.webp"><img src="./assets/vendor-details-badge.webp" alt="Vendor Detail Badge" /></a>

*(Vendor → Details section)*

- Admins can assign badges directly from the vendor profile page
- Multiple badges can be assigned based on vendor performance
- Assigned badges are immediately linked to the vendor account

**Example:**
A vendor completing **10,000+ successful sales** can be awarded the **Gold Badge**.

---

## Badge Display on Vendor Profile

The assigned badges are **visible to the customer at the vendor profile at the frontend**. This ensures that customers can immediately recognize verified and high-performing sellers directly from the shop page.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-profile-badges.webp"><img src="./assets/vendor-profile-badges.webp" alt="Vendor Profile Badge Display" /></a>

- Customers can view specific certifications such as **Top Rated Vendor** and **On Time Delivery**.
- The badges help customers quickly identify trusted and reliable marketplace partners.
- This visibility improves transparency and helps customers make faster, more confident purchase decisions.



---

## Benefits of Vendor Badges

- ✔ Builds trust and credibility
- ✔ Rewards top-performing vendors
- ✔ Motivates vendors to improve performance
- ✔ Enhances marketplace professionalism
- ✔ Improves customer decision-making

---

## Admin Vendors List

The admin can manage all vendors from the marketplace admin panel.

- **Bulk Approve and Disapprove**: Admins can easily perform bulk actions to approve or disapprove multiple vendors directly from the Vendors list.

<!-- <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/placeholder-bulk-approve.png"><img src="./assets/placeholder-bulk-approve.png" alt="Bulk Approve Vendors" /></a> -->

---

## Vendor Listing Page

- **Vendor Listing**: The selected Vendor page (configured in general settings) displays a listing of all active vendors on the storefront, allowing customers to easily browse and discover different stores.

<!-- <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/placeholder-vendor-listing.png"><img src="./assets/placeholder-vendor-listing.png" alt="Vendor Listing" /></a> -->

---

# Vendor Dashboard Menu

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/dashboard.webp"><img src="./assets/dashboard.webp" alt="Dashboard Print" /></a>

The **Vendor Dashboard** allows vendors to manage marketplace activities and access key functionalities similar to the admin panel.

---

## Vendor Dashboard Sections

- **Reports**
  - View quick infographic reports
  - Access recent orders summary
  - Check sales order history
  - Monitor:
    - Lifetime Sales
    - Total Payout
    - Remaining Amount
    - Refunded Amount

- **Order History**
  - View complete order-related history
  - Track orders placed by customers

- **Transaction**
  - View transaction-related details
  - Includes:
    - Transaction ID
    - Date
    - Transaction Amount

- **Notifications**
  - View order-related notifications
  - Receive product-related updates and alerts

- **Shop Followers**
  - Check the list of followers for the vendor shop
  - View customer queries related to the shop

- **My Profile**
  - Manage and update vendor profile information
  - Edit personal and shop-related details

- **Ask To Admin**
  - View queries raised with the admin
  - Track communication and responses from the admin

---

## Purpose

The Vendor Dashboard helps vendors efficiently manage their store, track performance, and communicate with the admin from a single interface.

---

# Vendor Product Management

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/product-management.webp"><img src="./assets/product-management.webp" alt="Product Management" /></a>

<!-- <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/product-list.webp"><img src="./assets/product-list.webp" alt="Product List" /></a> -->

Vendors can manage their products directly from the **Vendor Dashboard**, including adding, editing, and managing inventory and product details.

---

## Product Types Supported

Vendors can add the following **5 product types**:

- Simple Product
- Grouped Product
- External / Affiliate Product
- Variable Product
- Downloadable Product

---

## Vendor Product List

- Vendors can view all their products under **Product List**
- Available actions:
  - Search products
  - Edit products
  - Delete products
- Product status counters available:
  - Published
  - Low Stock
  - Out of Stock
  - Draft
  - On Sale

> Vendors can only see **admin-published products** if auto-publish is disabled by the admin.

---

## Edit Product

- Vendors can edit:
  - Basic product details
  - Inventory settings
  - Product status
- Edit options become available after product creation.

---

## Add Product

- Vendor clicks on **Add Product** from the dashboard menu.
- Select:
  - Product Category
  - Product Type
- Click **Next** to proceed.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/add-product.webp"><img src="./assets/add-product.webp" alt="Add Product" /></a>

---

## Product Details

Vendors must enter the following details:

- Product Name
- About Product
- Product Thumbnail
- Product SKU
- Regular Price
- Sale Price
- **Scheduled Sale Price**: For simple products, vendors can now schedule a sale price directly from the product add and edit pages.
- Short Description

Click **Save** after entering details.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/product-detail.webp"><img src="./assets/product-detail.webp" alt="Product Details" /></a>

---

## Minimum Order & Quantity Settings

- Vendors can manage:
  - Minimum order amount for checkout
  - Maximum purchase quantity
- Accessible via **Change Product Miscellaneous Settings**

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/miscellaneous-setting.webp"><img src="./assets/miscellaneous-setting.webp" alt="Miscellaneous Settings" /></a>

---

## Inventory Management

- Enable **Stock Management at Product Level**
- Configure:
  - Stock Quantity
  - Backorders (Allow / Not Allow / Allow but Notify)
  - Low Stock Threshold
  - Sell Individually option
  - Max Purchasable Quantity

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/edit-seller-product.webp"><img src="./assets/edit-seller-product.webp" alt="Inventory Settings" /></a>

---

## Shipping Details

- Vendors can enter product-specific shipping information.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-product-shipping.webp"><img src="./assets/seller-product-shipping.webp" alt="Product Shipping" /></a>

---

## Linked Products

- Vendors can add:
  - Upsell products
  - Cross-sell products

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-linked-product.webp"><img src="./assets/seller-linked-product.webp" alt="Linked Products" /></a>

---

## Attributes Management

- Vendors can add multiple attributes as required.
- Options include:
  - Use existing attributes
  - Make attributes visible on product page

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-attribute.webp"><img src="./assets/seller-attribute.webp" alt="Attributes" /></a>

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-add-attribute.webp"><img src="./assets/seller-add-attribute.webp" alt="Add Attribute" /></a>

- Attributes appear under **Additional Information** section.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/washable.webp"><img src="./assets/washable.webp" alt="Attribute Display" /></a>

---

## Attributes Tab (UX Improvement)

- While editing products:
  - An **Ajax loader** appears on the Attributes tab
  - Indicates attribute terms are being fetched
  - Prevents repeated clicks

- Vendors can:
  - Use admin-created attributes
  - Request new or updated attributes via **Ask Admin**

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/attribute.webp"><img src="./assets/attribute.webp" alt="Attributes Tab" /></a>

---

## Product Tags & Brands

- Vendors can add and manage:
  - Product Tags
  - Product Brands
- Helps improve:
  - Product categorization
  - Search visibility

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/tag-and-brands.webp"><img src="./assets/tag-and-brands.webp" alt="Tags and Brands" /></a>

> Tags and brands are visible on the product page.

---

## Product Status

- Vendors can set product status as:
  - **Online**
  - **Draft**
- If set to **Online**:
  - Product is published only if admin permission is granted

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/product-status.webp"><img src="./assets/product-status.webp" alt="Product Status" /></a>

---

## Virtual & Downloadable Products

- Vendors can mark products as:
  - Virtual
  - Downloadable

### Downloadable Product Settings

- File Name
- File URL
- Download Limit
- Expiry Date

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/downloadable-product.webp"><img src="./assets/downloadable-product.webp" alt="Downloadable Product" /></a>

---

## Final Product Creation

- After saving:
  - Product appears in **Product List**

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/product-list.webp"><img src="./assets/product-list.webp" alt="Final Product Created" /></a>

- Product is live on the frontend for customers.

---

## Product Translations (WPML)

Vendors can easily translate their products into configured WPML languages directly from the frontend product edit page.

- A new **Translations** tab is available when editing a product.
- Supports translating simple products and variable-product variations.
- *Note: Requires WPML and WooCommerce Multilingual. The separate Marketplace WPML Integration add-on is no longer needed.*

<!-- <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/placeholder-wpml-translations.png"><img src="./assets/placeholder-wpml-translations.png" alt="WPML Product Translations" /></a> -->

# Vendor Order Management

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/order-management.webp"><img src="./assets/order-management.webp" alt="order-management" /></a>

<!-- <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/order-history.webp"><img src="./assets/order-history.webp" alt="Order History" /></a> -->

Vendors can manage all order-related activities directly from the **Vendor Dashboard** under the **Order History** section.

---

## Access Order History

- Vendors navigate to **Order History** from the Vendor Dashboard.
- Displays a list of all orders related to the vendor’s products.

---

## View Order Details

- Click on the **View** button to open complete order details.
- Vendors can:
  - View customer and product information
  - View an **Order summary line and subtotal** to quickly understand the order's financial details
  - Upload a **custom invoice** for the order
  - Manage order-related actions

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/order-details.jpeg"><img src="./assets/order-details.jpeg" alt="Order Details View" /></a>

---

## Upload Custom Invoice

- Vendors can upload their **personalized invoice file** directly from the order details page.
- Supported if invoice upload is enabled by the admin.

---

## Update Order Status

- Vendors can update the **order status** as required.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/woocommerce-marketplace.webp"><img src="./assets/woocommerce-marketplace.webp" alt="Order Status Update" /></a>

- After updating:
  - The change is recorded automatically in **Order Notes**.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/order-notes.webp"><img src="./assets/order-notes.webp" alt="Order Notes" /></a>

---

## Print Invoice

- Vendors can print the invoice by clicking the **Print Invoice** button.
- The button is available at the **top-right corner** of the order details page.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/invoice-button.webp"><img src="./assets/invoice-button.webp" alt="Seller Invoice button" /></a>

**Invoice Preview**

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-invoice.webp"><img src="./assets/seller-invoice.webp" alt="Seller Invoice Print" /></a>

---

## Generate Refund (Vendor End)

Vendors can generate refund requests for eligible orders.

### Steps to Generate a Refund

1. Navigate to **Order History** in the Vendor Dashboard.
2. Click **View** for the order to be refunded.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/order-history.webp"><img src="./assets/order-history.webp" alt="Order History" /></a>

3. On the order details page, click the **Refund** tab (visible at the top).

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/order-details.jpeg"><img src="./assets/order-details.jpeg" alt="Refund Tab" /></a>


4. Configure the refund options:
   - Refund Quantity
   - Refund Shipping (optional)
   - Restock Refunded Items (optional)

5. Click on **Refund Manually**.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/approve-refund.webp"><img src="./assets/approve-refund.webp" alt="Approve Refund" /></a>

---

## Refund Confirmation

- After successful refund:
  - A message **“Refunded successfully”** appears at the top of the page.
  - The refunded amount is reflected under the **Order Total** section.

  <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/refunded.webp"><img src="./assets/refunded.webp" alt="Approve Refund" /></a>


---

## Summary

- Vendors can:
  - View and manage orders
  - Upload and print invoices
  - Update order status
  - Generate refunds manually
- All actions are tracked and updated in the order history and notes.

---

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-transaction-management.html -->

# Vendor Transaction Management

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-transaction.webp"><img src="./assets/admin-transaction.webp" alt="Seller Transactions" /></a>

The **Vendor Transaction Management** section allows vendors to track payments received from the admin for completed orders where the admin has collected payments from buyers.

---

## Access Transactions

- Vendors can access transactions from the **Vendor Dashboard**.
- This section displays all transactions processed by the admin for vendor orders.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-transactions.webp"><img src="./assets/seller-transactions.webp" alt="Seller Transactions" /></a>

---

## Transaction Overview

Vendors can view the following transaction-related details:

- **Total Earning** – Total amount earned from completed orders
- **Total Withdrawal** – Total amount already withdrawn
- **Total Pending** – Amount pending for withdrawal
- **Total Refunded** – Total refunded amount
- **Last Withdrawal** – Details of the most recent withdrawal
- **Minimum Withdrawal Amount** – Minimum balance required to request a withdrawal

---

## Create a Withdrawal Request

- Click on the **Withdrawal** button to initiate a withdrawal request.
- Vendor is redirected to the **Withdrawal Request** page.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/webkul-woocommerce-marketplace-withdrawal.webp"><img src="./assets/webkul-woocommerce-marketplace-withdrawal.webp" alt="Withdrawal Page" /></a>

---

## Withdrawal Management

From the withdrawal page, vendors can:

- View available **withdrawal payment methods**
- Set a **default withdrawal method**
- Check **recent withdrawal requests**

To request a new withdrawal:

- Click on **Request Withdrawal**


<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-create-withdrawal-request.webp"><img src="./assets/vendor-create-withdrawal-request.webp" alt="Create Withdrawal Request" /></a>

---

## Submit Withdrawal Request

- Enter the required withdrawal details.
- Click on **Submit Request** to send the withdrawal request to the admin.

---

## View Transaction Details

- Vendors can click on the **View** option for any transaction.
- This displays:
  - Vendor’s earned amount
  - Admin commission for the order


<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/transaction-details.webp"><img src="./assets/transaction-details.webp" alt="Transaction Details" /></a>

---

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-payout-management.html -->

# Vendors Payout Management

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendors-payout-management.webp"><img src="./assets/vendors-payout-management.webp" alt="Vendors Payout Management" /></a>

Admins can now review pending payouts, filter and search by vendor or status, and run bulk Mark-as-Paid or CSV Export in one click — backed by six dedicated REST routes.

This also ships:
- **Category Filter**: Inline product count and product search on the seller profile.
- **Frontend Bulk Actions**: Assign Categories and Publish actions directly on the seller product list.
- **Data-Driven Seller-Profile Tabs**: Optimized profile tabs for addons.
---

## Vendors Payout Dashboard Features

The new Vendors Payout Management dashboard provides a centralized view for admins to track vendor orders, commissions, payment methods, and seller payouts.

### Dashboard Highlights

- **Payable Withdrawals & Unpaid Amounts**: View total pending payable requests and total unpaid payout amounts at a glance.
- **Total Commission Earned**: Monitor total marketplace commission earnings.
- **Unpaid Vendors**: Track the number of vendors with unpaid payouts.

### Payout Management Capabilities

- **Review Pending Payouts**: Easily review all requested withdrawals from vendors.

#### Filter and Search

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-payout-filter.webp"><img src="./assets/vendor-payout-filter.webp" alt="Vendor Payout Filters" /></a>

Admins can use the advanced filtering and searching tools to locate specific payout records quickly:
- **Filter by Vendor**: Select a specific vendor from the dropdown (e.g., "Blue Heaven's Store" or "ElectroMart") to view only their pending or completed payout requests.
- **Filter by Status**: View payouts by their current status, such as "Pending", to isolate pending requests.
- **Search by Withdrawal ID**: Quickly find a specific withdrawal request by entering its unique ID in the search bar.

#### Bulk Actions

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-payout-bulk-actions.webp"><img src="./assets/vendor-payout-bulk-actions.webp" alt="Vendor Payout Bulk Actions" /></a>

For efficient management of multiple withdrawal requests, admins can utilize the bulk actions menu:
- **Mark as Paid**: Select multiple pending withdrawals using the checkboxes on the left, then run the "Mark as Paid" bulk action to clear them all in a single click.
- **Export CSV**: Download a comprehensive CSV file containing the selected payout records for offline accounting and external record-keeping.

#### Individual Payouts

- **Pay Now**: Admins can also manage transactions individually by clicking the **Pay Now** button located next to any withdrawal request to quickly process a specific payout.

---

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-shipping-zone-management.html -->

# Add New Shipping Zone

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/Shipping.webp"><img src="./assets/Shipping.webp" alt="Shipping" /></a>

<!-- <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/shipping-created.webp"><img src="./assets/shipping-created.webp" alt="Shipping Created" /></a> -->


Vendors can manage shipping zones and shipping methods directly from their vendor dashboard.

---

## Add New Shipping Zone

To create a new shipping zone:

1. Navigate to **Shipping** from the vendor dashboard.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/before-shipping-created.webp"><img src="./assets/before-shipping-created.webp" alt="Before Shipping Created" /></a>

2. Click on **Add New Shipping Zone**.
3. Enter the following details:
   - **Zone Name**
   - **Zone Regions**
4. Click on **Add Shipping Zone** to save the zone.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/shipping-zone.webp"><img src="./assets/shipping-zone.webp" alt="Shipping Zone" /></a>

---

## Edit Shipping Zone

After creating the shipping zone:

1. Go back to the **Shipping** section.
2. Click the **Edit** button for the shipping zone where you want to add shipping methods.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/edit-shipping-zone.webp"><img src="./assets/edit-shipping-zone.webp" alt="Edit Shipping Zone" /></a>

---

## Add Shipping Method

1. On the Shipping Zone edit page, click on **Add Shipping Method**.
2. A popup window will appear to select a shipping method.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/add-shipping.webp"><img src="./assets/add-shipping.webp" alt="Add Shipping" /></a>

---

## Select Shipping Method

1. Choose a shipping method from the dropdown list in the popup.
2. Click **Add Shipping Method** to assign it to the shipping zone.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-shipping-popup.webp"><img src="./assets/seller-shipping-popup.webp" alt="Seller Shipping Popup" /></a>

---

## Configure Shipping Method

1. After adding the shipping method, you will be redirected back to the **Shipping Zone** page.
2. Click on the **shipping method name** to configure its cost.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-shipping2.webp"><img src="./assets/seller-shipping2.webp" alt="Seller Shipping" /></a>

---

## Set Shipping Cost

A configuration popup will appear where the vendor can:

- Enter the **Shipping Cost**
- Configure **Shipping Class Costs**
- Add any additional shipping-related details

Click **Save Changes** after configuration.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/add-shipping-method.webp"><img src="./assets/add-shipping-method.webp" alt="Add Shipping Method" /></a>
<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/shipping-additional-details.webp"><img src="./assets/shipping-additional-details.webp" alt="Shipping Additional Details" /></a>

---

## Save Shipping Method

- After saving the changes, the shipping method will be successfully added.
- The configured shipping method will now be visible under the respective shipping zone.

---

## Summary

- Vendors can create and manage shipping zones.
- Multiple shipping methods can be added per zone.
- Shipping costs and class-based charges can be customized per method.
- All configurations are manageable from the vendor dashboard.

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/admin-news-vendor.html -->

# Vendor Staff

The **Vendor Staff** feature allows vendors to add sub-users (store managers) who can log in and manage the store on their behalf. Vendors can grant per-task permissions for each section (view, add, edit, delete, and more) based on the capabilities allowed by the admin.

---

## Managing Vendor Staff

Vendors can view a list of all their staff members from the Vendor Dashboard.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-staff-list.png"><img src="./assets/vendor-staff-list.png" alt="Vendor Staff List" /></a>

### Adding a New Staff Member

To add a new staff member, click on the **Add Staff** button. Fill in the required details such as Name, Email, and Password.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/add-vendor-staff.png"><img src="./assets/add-vendor-staff.png" alt="Add Vendor Staff" /></a>

### Editing Staff Settings and Permissions

Vendors can edit existing staff settings and define precise permissions for what the staff member is allowed to do. 

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/edit-vedor-staff-setting.png"><img src="./assets/edit-vedor-staff-setting.png" alt="Edit Vendor Staff Setting" /></a>

The permissions can be granularly controlled per section (e.g., Products, Orders, Profile) and per action (e.g., view, add, edit, delete).

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/allowed-staff-to-do.png"><img src="./assets/allowed-staff-to-do.png" alt="Allowed Staff Permissions" /></a>

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/allowed-staff-to-do-2.png"><img src="./assets/allowed-staff-to-do-2.png" alt="Allowed Staff Permissions Continued" /></a>

---

This allows vendors to easily scale their operations by delegating tasks to their team members while maintaining strict control over their store's security and data.

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-profile.html -->

# Vendor Profile

The **Vendor Profile** displays important information about a vendor and helps customers understand the vendor’s store, policies, and credibility.

---

## Vendor Profile Overview

- After successful registration, the vendor must complete their profile under **Vendor Profile**.
- The profile contains essential vendor and shop-related information divided into multiple tabs for easier navigation.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/profile.png"><img src="./assets/profile.png" alt="Vendor Profile Settings" /></a>

## 1. General Tab
The **General** tab contains the vendor's basic information:
- **Personal Details**: Username, First Name, Last Name, and E-Mail.
- **Read-only Applied Commission**: Vendors can view their currently applied commission rate (falling back to the global default if no specific commission is set).

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/general.png"><img src="./assets/general.png" alt="Seller Profile General Tab" /></a>

---

## 2. Shop Tab
The **Shop** tab allows the vendor to configure their store details, policies, and SEO settings.
- Vendors can define their shop title, description, and contact information.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/shop.png"><img src="./assets/shop.png" alt="Seller Profile Shop Tab" /></a>

---

## 3. Images Tab
Vendors can upload various images to brand their store from the **Images** tab.
- Allowed file types typically include: `jpg, jpeg, png, webp, gif`.
- **User Image**: The vendor's personal avatar.
- **Shop Logo**: The logo representing the store.
- **Fulfillment Image**: An image or badge displayed for order fulfillment.
- **Banner Image**: A large banner for the store. Vendors can choose whether to display it by checking the "Show banner on vendor page" option.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-and-store-image.png"><img src="./assets/vendor-and-store-image.png" alt="Seller Profile Images Tab" /></a>

---

## 4. Social Profile Tab
Vendors can link their social media accounts to their store to build trust and increase engagement.
- Available optional fields include: **Facebook**, **Instagram**, **X (Formerly Twitter)**, **LinkedIn**, **Youtube**, and **Pinterest**.
- These links will be displayed on the vendor's public store page.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/social-profile.png"><img src="./assets/social-profile.png" alt="Seller Profile Social Tab" /></a>

---

## 5. Store Hours Tab

Vendors can set a weekly schedule from the **Store Hours** tab with per-day Open/Closed toggles and multiple time slots per day.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-profile-store-hour.png"><img src="./assets/seller-profile-store-hour.png" alt="Store Hours Settings" /></a>

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-profile-store-hour-2.png"><img src="./assets/seller-profile-store-hour-2.png" alt="Store Hours Profile View" /></a>

### Features of Store Hours:
- The schedule is displayed on the vendor profile page and on a hover tooltip when the store is closed.
- **Optional Blocking**: An admin setting can optionally block purchases while the store is closed.
- **Closed Notices**: Custom admin-configurable messages can be shown on the listing button and single product notice.
- **Hide Products**: When the store is closed, products can optionally be hidden from the shop, archive, and search, while remaining visible on the vendor profile.

---

## 6. KYC Tab

The **KYC** (Know Your Customer) tab allows vendors to upload their identity documents for admin verification.
- For detailed information, see the full [Vendor KYC Verification](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-kyc.html) documentation.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-kyc-page.png"><img src="./assets/seller-kyc-page.png" alt="Seller Profile KYC Tab" /></a>

---

## 7. Profile View Tab

Vendors can choose how their public store page looks from a dedicated **Profile View** tab.
- **Live Preview**: The page features a live preview that updates instantly as you switch between styles.
- **Storefront**: Features a modern store page with an info sidebar (contact details, store hours, map) and a product gallery.
- **Spotlight**: Features a full-width hero banner with your products front and center, and an "About this Vendor" panel.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/profile-view.png"><img src="./assets/profile-view.png" alt="Profile View Selection" /></a>

---

## Vendor Dashboard Access

- If the admin enables the **admin-like dashboard** for vendors:
  - Vendors can see the **Admin Dashboard** option in the left-side account panel.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-dashboard.webp"><img src="./assets/vendor-dashboard.webp" alt="Vendor Admin Dashboard Menu" /></a>

---

## Google Analytics for Vendors

- Vendors can add their **own Google Analytics Account ID**.
- Vendors can enable tracking events such as:
  - **View Item**
  - **Purchase Event**

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/account-id.webp"><img src="./assets/account-id.webp" alt="Vendor Google Analytics Settings" /></a>

---
## Tax System Settings

After configuring **Google Analytics**, vendors can set up their **tax information** directly from the vendor profile edit page.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/profile-profile.webp"><img src="./assets/profile-profile.webp" alt="Vendor Tax System Settings" /></a>

### Key Points

- Vendors can select their applicable **Tax System** from the dropdown, such as:
  - **GSTIN**
  - **SSN**
  - **VAT**
- Based on the selected tax system:
  - A corresponding **Tax Identification Number** field appears (e.g., GSTIN number) on the vendor’s public profile page.
- Vendors can enter and save their tax details securely

---

## Vendor Policies

- Vendors can add and manage the following policies:
  - **Return Policy**
  - **Shipping Policy**
  - **Privacy Policy**
- These policies are displayed on the vendor’s public profile page.

- If the vendor selects the **admin-like view**:
  - The vendor profile layout changes to match the admin-style dashboard.

- Vendors are **restricted from purchasing their own products**.
- This helps prevent:
  - Fake orders

- **Edit Product link** added on the vendor’s own product view page
  - Allows vendors to quickly edit their products from the frontend

# Vacation Mode

The **Vacation Mode** allows vendors to temporarily close their store when they are unavailable. When enabled, the storefront displays a vacation notice with the vendor's custom message and blocks customer purchases.

---

## Enabling Vacation Mode

Vendors can schedule a vacation directly from their Vendor Dashboard.

To view current or past vacations, vendors can navigate to the Vacation section to see a sortable list of their vacations.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vacation-list.png"><img src="./assets/vacation-list.png" alt="Vacation List" /></a>

### Adding a Vacation

To schedule a new vacation, click on the **Add Vacation** button. Vendors can set the start and end dates, and provide a custom vacation message that will be displayed to customers on the storefront.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/add-vacation.png"><img src="./assets/add-vacation.png" alt="Add Vacation" /></a>

### Editing a Vacation

Vendors can update an upcoming or ongoing vacation by editing the dates or the display message.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/edit-vacation.png"><img src="./assets/edit-vacation.png" alt="Edit Vacation" /></a>

---

## Admin Controls for Vacation Mode

Admins have full control over the Vacation Mode feature:
- Enable or disable the vacation feature globally.
- Edit a specific vendor's vacation.
- Bulk enable, disable, or delete vacations from a sortable list in the admin panel.
- Configure settings and endpoint options for the vacation menu.

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-kyc.html -->

# Vendor KYC Verification

The **Vendor KYC (Know Your Customer) Verification** feature allows admins to securely verify the identity of their vendors. It ensures marketplace compliance and builds trust with customers.

---

## KYC Verification Workflow

### Admin Configuration
Admins have full control over the KYC process:
- A master toggle to enable or disable KYC verification globally.
- Admin-managed document types (e.g., Passport, ID Card, Driver's License).
- Configurable allowed file formats and maximum file size limits for document uploads.



### Vendor Document Upload
Vendors can easily upload their KYC documents to get verified. This can be done at two stages:
1. **At Registration**: During the vendor registration process.
2. **From My Profile**: After registration, from the "My Profile" tab in their Vendor Dashboard.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/upload-kyc.png"><img src="./assets/upload-kyc.png" alt="Vendor KYC Upload" /></a>

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-kyc-page.png"><img src="./assets/seller-kyc-page.png" alt="Vendor KYC Upload from Profile" /></a>

### Admin Review and Action
Admins can review submitted documents from the admin vendor list. A dedicated KYC column and row action are available to streamline this process.

Clicking to review a vendor's KYC opens a review screen offering three actions:
- **Approve**: Mark the vendor's KYC as verified.
- **Reject (with reason)**: Reject the document and provide a reason, allowing the vendor to re-upload.
- **Hard Reject**: Permanently reject the vendor's KYC application.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-vendor-list-kyc-pending.png"><img src="./assets/admin-vendor-list-kyc-pending.png" alt="Admin Vendor List - KYC Pending" /></a>

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-verify-vendor-kyc.png"><img src="./assets/admin-verify-vendor-kyc.png" alt="Admin Verify Vendor KYC" /></a>

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-approve-vendor-kyc.png"><img src="./assets/admin-approve-vendor-kyc.png" alt="Admin Approve Vendor KYC" /></a>

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-vendor-list-kyc-approve.png"><img src="./assets/admin-vendor-list-kyc-approve.png" alt="Admin Vendor List - KYC Approved" /></a>

### Email Notifications
To keep vendors informed, automatic emails are sent out during the process:
- Vendor email on **KYC Approval**.
- Vendor email on **KYC Rejection** (including the admin's reason).
- Vendor email on **KYC Hard Rejection**.

Additionally, a vendor email is sent automatically if the admin completely **deletes their account**.

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-notification.html -->

- Vendors can quickly review updates without navigating to different sections.

# Vendor Shop Followers

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/shop-follower.webp"><img src="./assets/shop-follower.webp" alt="Shop Follower Icon" /></a>

The **Vendor Shop Followers** feature allows vendors to engage directly with buyers who follow their shop by sending notifications and updates.

---

## Shop Followers Overview

- Buyers can follow a vendor’s shop directly from the **product page**.
- A buyer becomes a shop follower by clicking the **heart-shaped icon** on the product page.

---

## Manage Shop Followers

- Vendors can view all their shop followers under the **Shop Followers** section in the vendor dashboard.
- This section displays the complete list of followers associated with the vendor’s shop.

**Reference Media:**

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/followers.webp"><img src="./assets/followers.webp" alt="Shop Followers List" /></a>

---

## Send Notifications to Followers

- Vendors can send notifications to their shop followers to:
  - Share updates.
  - Promote new products.
  - Inform about offers or announcements.
- To send a notification:
  - Select one or more followers from the list.
  - Click on **Send Notification**.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/send-notification.webp"><img src="./assets/send-notification.webp" alt="Shop Followers List" /></a>


---

## Notification Popup

- A popup window appears to enter the notification details.
- After entering the required information:
  - Click **Send Mail** to dispatch the notification email to the selected followers.

---

## Benefits

- Helps vendors build stronger relationships with customers.
- Improves engagement through direct communication.
- Enables quick promotion of products and updates.
