# Ask To Admin

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/question-list.webp"><img src="./assets/question-list.png" alt="Ask To Admin Button" /></a>

The **Ask To Admin** feature allows vendors to directly communicate with the marketplace admin for queries, clarifications, or support.

---

## Ask To Admin Overview

- Vendors can inquire about anything related to the marketplace.
- This option is available in the **vendor dashboard** under **Ask To Admin**.

---

## How Vendors Ask a Query

- Navigate to **Ask To Admin** from the vendor dashboard.
- Click on the **Add** button to raise a new query.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/ask-admin.webp"><img src="./assets/ask-admin.webp" alt="Ask To Admin Button" /></a>

---

## Submit a Query

- Vendors need to:
  - Enter the **Subject** of the query.
  - Write the detailed **query/message**.
- Click on the **Ask** button to submit the query.

---

## Admin Notification & Threaded Chat

- Once the vendor submits the query:
  - The **admin receives an email notification** regarding the vendor’s query.
- **Threaded "Ask a Question to Admin"**: Vendor and admin replies form a chat-style thread on both the storefront and the admin panel, keeping the conversation history organized and easy to track.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/ask-to-admin.png"><img src="./assets/ask-to-admin.png" alt="Ask to Admin Thread" /></a>

---

## Benefits

- Direct communication channel between vendor and admin.
- Helps vendors resolve issues or doubts quickly.
- Improves overall marketplace support and transparency.

---

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/admin-panel-management.html -->

# Marketplace Admin Panel Management

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/Product-mangement.webp"><img src="./assets/Product-mangement.webp" alt="Product List – All Products" /></a>

After installing the **WooCommerce Marketplace plugin**, an additional Marketplace tab appears in the WordPress admin panel. From here admin can manage **Marketplace vendors, products, reviews etc.**

---

## Marketplace Overview

From the admin panel, the admin can manage:

- Vendors
- Products
- Commissions
- Marketplace settings (such as product auto-publish and vendor auto-approval)

---

## Product Management by Admin

- The admin can create and publish all types of products:
  - Simple
  - Virtual
  - Downloadable
  - Grouped
  - External / Affiliate
  - Variable
- Products can be assigned to one or more vendors.
- The admin has full control over vendor-created products.

---

## Product List (Admin End)

In the **Product List**, the admin can:

- View both **admin** and **vendor** products
- Edit or delete any product
- Modify any product specification created by vendors
- Filter products by vendor
- Mass-assign products to vendors
- **Screen Options**: Admins can easily show or hide specific columns on the admin Products listing page using the standard Screen Options menu to customize their view.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/productlist-1.webp"><img src="./assets/productlist-1.webp" alt="Product List – All Products" /></a>

---

## Filter Products by Vendor

- Admin can filter the product list based on a specific vendor.
- Once filtered, only the selected vendor’s products will be displayed.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/filter-by-vendor.webp"><img src="./assets/filter-by-vendor.webp" alt="Product List – Vendor Filtered" /></a>

---

## Assign Products to Vendor

- Select:
  - One or more products
  - A vendor from the dropdown
- Click the **Assign** button to assign selected products to the chosen vendor.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/assign-vendor.webp"><img src="./assets/assign-vendor.webp" alt="Assign Products to Vendor" /></a>

---

## Vendor Product Approval (Manual Publish)

If the admin has configured **Allow Vendor to Publish** as **unchecked**:

- Vendor-added products will be created in **Draft** status.
- Admin must manually review and publish the product.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/allow-seller-woocommerce-marketplace.webp"><img src="./assets/allow-seller-woocommerce-marketplace.webp" alt="Allow Vendor to Publish Setting" /></a>

---

## Draft Product Visibility

- When a vendor adds a product:
  - Product status remains **Draft**
  - Product is visible in the admin product list

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/Productlist-3.webp"><img src="./assets/Productlist-3.webp" alt="Draft Product in Admin List" /></a>

---

## Publish Vendor Product

- Admin edits the draft product.
- Clicks the **Publish** button.
- Product becomes live on the storefront.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/product-list.webp"><img src="./assets/product-list.webp" alt="Publish Vendor Product" /></a>

---

## Frontend Visibility

- Once published, the product is:
  - Visible to customers on the frontend
  - Available for purchase like any other WooCommerce product

---

## Key Benefits

- Full administrative control over marketplace products
- Secure approval workflow for vendor products
- Easy product-to-vendor assignment
- Centralized product management for large marketplaces

---

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-management-and-product-assignment.html -->

# Assign Product to Vendor
<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/assign-product.webp"><img src="./assets/assign-product.webp" alt="assign Product to Vendor" /></a>

The admin can assign products to vendors directly from the **product edit page**.

---

## Assign Product from Product Page

- The admin can assign any product to a vendor from the **right column** of the product edit page.
- Search and select the vendor name from the vendor list.
- Assign the product to the selected vendor.

### Key Points

- Admin can assign:
  - Admin-created products to vendors
  - One vendor’s product to another vendor
- If a product is reassigned:
  - It will no longer appear in the **previous vendor’s product list**
  - It will appear in the **new vendor’s product list**

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/woocommerce-marketplace-transfer-seller.webp"><img src="./assets/woocommerce-marketplace-transfer-seller.webp" alt="Transfer Product to Vendor" /></a>

## Vendor List – WooCommerce Marketplace

The **Vendor List** allows the admin to manage all vendors from the WooCommerce admin panel.

---

### Vendor List Features

- View full vendor bio and profile details
- Edit vendor profile via the **Username** link
- Approve or disapprove vendors

### Editable Sections Include

- Personal options
- Name & contact information
- About page
- Account management
- Billing address
- Shipping address

---

## Add New Vendor

The admin can add a new vendor manually by navigating to:

**Marketplace → Vendors → Add New**

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendors-list.webp"><img src="./assets/vendors-list.webp" alt="Vendors List" /></a>

---

### Vendor Creation Steps

- Fill in vendor details such as:
  - Username
  - Email
  - Role (Seller)
  - Profile and shop details
- Save the vendor to add them to the marketplace

## Manage Vendor

Click the **Manage** button next to a vendor to access vendor management options.

---

## Vendor Details

From the **Details** section, the admin can:

- View vendor information:
  - Username
  - Email
  - Display name
  - Shop address
- Enter and update vendor **payment details**

---

## Vendor Orders

- Admin can view all orders related to a vendor.
- Admin can mark orders as **paid** to the vendor.

### Pay Vendor for an Order

- Click the **Pay** button under the order actions.
- This creates a transaction for the order.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-order.webp"><img src="./assets/seller-order.webp" alt="Vendor Orders" /></a>

## Transactions in WooCommerce Marketplace

- Order is marked as **paid**

### Product Category Settings

- **Allowed Categories**:
  - Define which categories the vendor can use when adding products

### Order Approval

  - Vendor sees orders and receives notifications only after **admin approval**

  - Automatically prefixes vendor SKU

# Commission Management

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/marketplace-settings.webp"><img src="./assets/marketplace-settings.webp" alt="Marketplace Commission Settings" /></a>

The **Commission Management** feature allows the admin to define how commissions are calculated and distributed between the admin and vendors.

---

## Global Commission Configuration

- The admin can set a **Fixed Commission** and a **Percentage Commission**.
- These commission rules apply to **all vendors** by default.
- Configuration path:
  - **Marketplace → Settings → Commission**

---

## Commission Calculation Example

- Fixed Commission: **5 USD**
- Percentage Commission: **10%**
- Product Price: **100 USD**

### Calculation

- Percentage Commission: 10% of 100 USD = **10 USD**
- Fixed Commission: **5 USD**
- **Total Admin Commission:** 15 USD
- **Vendor Earnings:** 85 USD

---

## Order Management (Commission View)

The commission details are visible from the **Orders section** and not from the Commission settings page.

### Navigation Path

- Go to **Marketplace → Orders**
- This opens the **Marketplace Orders listing page**

### Commission Details in Orders

Under the **Orders** tab, the admin can view detailed commission-related information for each order.

#### Visible Columns

- Order ID
- Product
- Quantity
- Product Total
- Shipping
- Discount
- **Total Commission**
- **Total Vendor Amount**
- Action

This section helps the admin track:
- Commission earned per order
- Final payable amount to the vendor

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/sellers-orders-list.webp"><img src="./assets/sellers-orders-list.webp" alt="Seller Orders List" /></a>

---

## Vendor-Specific Commission

The admin can configure commission rates for individual vendors from the **Vendor Management** section.

### Navigation Path

- Go to **Marketplace → Vendors**
- The list of all registered vendors will be displayed
- Click on the **Vendor Name** to manage commission settings

### Vendor Commission Configuration

- Clicking on the **Vendor Name** redirects the admin to the **Vendor Profile / Commission page**
- From here, the admin can:
  - Set a **vendor-specific fixed commission**
  - Set a **vendor-specific percentage commission**
  - Override the **global commission settings** if required

> **Note:** Vendor-specific commission settings take precedence over global commission settings.

---

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/manage-feedback-and-vendor-queries.html -->

# Marketplace Reviews & Ratings

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-manage-feedback.webp"><img src="./assets/admin-manage-feedback.webp" alt="Manage Feedback" /></a>

The **Marketplace Reviews & Ratings** feature allows the admin to manage customer reviews and ratings submitted for vendor products across the marketplace.

---

## Manage Customer Reviews & Ratings

The admin can review and control feedback submitted by customers for vendor products.

### Key Features

- Admin can **approve or disapprove**:
  - Product reviews
  - Product ratings
- Only **approved reviews and ratings** are visible on the storefront.
- Vendors can view approved customer feedback from their **vendor dashboard**.
- Helps maintain review quality and build customer trust.

### Navigation Path

- **Marketplace → Reviews & Ratings**

---

### Review Management Interface

The review management section displays:
- Customer name
- Vendor name
- Product name
- Rating
- Review message
- Approval status
- Action options (Approve / Disapprove)

**Reference Media:**

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/manage-feedback.webp"><img src="./assets/manage-feedback.webp" alt="Manage Feedback" /></a>

---

## Summary – Marketplace Reviews & Ratings

- Centralized control over customer reviews and ratings
- Approval-based visibility ensures quality content
- Vendors can view feedback related to their products
- Improves marketplace transparency and credibility

# Vendor Queries Management

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/queries.png"><img src="./assets/queries.png" alt="Queries List" /></a>

The **Vendor Queries Management** feature allows vendors to raise questions or concerns directly to the marketplace admin.

---

## Manage Vendor Queries

This section provides a dedicated interface for handling vendor inquiries.

### Navigation Path

- **Marketplace → Queries**

---

### Vendor Query List

The admin can view all queries raised by vendors, including:
- Vendor name
- Query subject
- Query message
- Date of submission

This helps the admin track and manage vendor communications efficiently.

---

### Reply to Vendor Queries

- Admin can respond to vendor queries directly from the admin panel.
- Click the **Reply** button against a specific query.
- The response is sent to the vendor for further communication or clarification.
- **Threaded View**: Both the vendor and admin can view the entire back-and-forth conversation as a threaded chat history to easily track the context of the issue.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-answered-to-query.png"><img src="./assets/admin-answered-to-query.png" alt="Admin Answered to Query Thread" /></a>

---

## Summary – Vendor Queries Management

- Vendors can communicate directly with the admin
- Admin can view and manage all vendor queries from a single location
- Enables faster resolution of vendor issues
- Improves vendor–admin communication within the marketplace

---

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/email-configurations.html -->

# Email Configurations

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/manage-email-listings.webp"><img src="./assets/manage-email-listings.webp" alt="Email Template Settings" /></a>

The WooCommerce Marketplace plugin allows the admin to configure and manage **email templates** used for marketplace-related notifications.

---

## Configuration Path

- Navigate to:
  **WooCommerce > Settings > Emails**

---

## Email Templates Management

- Admin can **customize email templates** for marketplace-related events.
- A hyperlink **“Click here to preview your email template”** is available to preview the email layout.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/webkul-woocommerce-multi-vendor-marketplace-email-template-configuration.webp"><img src="./assets/webkul-woocommerce-multi-vendor-marketplace-email-template-configuration.webp" alt="Email Template Configuration" /></a>

---

## Email Template Preview

- Clicking the preview link displays the **email layout and design**.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/webkul-woocommerce-multi-vendor-marketplace-email-template-preview.webp"><img src="./assets/webkul-woocommerce-multi-vendor-marketplace-email-template-preview.webp" alt="Email Template Preview" /></a>

---

## Available Marketplace Email Templates

The admin can manage multiple marketplace email templates, such as:

- Ask to Admin
- Product Publish
- Vendor Approval
- Vendor Registration
- Other marketplace notification emails

These templates are listed under:

- **WooCommerce > Settings > Emails**

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/webkul-woocommerce-multi-vendor-marketplace-email-listings.webp"><img src="./assets/webkul-woocommerce-multi-vendor-marketplace-email-listings.webp" alt="Email Template Listings" /></a>

---

## Configure Individual Email Template

- Click the **Manage** button next to the required email template.
- The admin can configure:
  - Enable / Disable email
  - Email subject
  - Email heading
  - Email content and additional settings

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/manage-email-listings.webp"><img src="./assets/manage-email-listings.webp" alt="Email Template Settings" /></a>

---

This feature gives the admin **full control over marketplace email communication** with vendors and customers.

# Admin Notifications

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/product-notification.webp"><img src="./assets/product-notification.webp" alt="Admin Notifications" /></a>

The **Admin Notifications** feature keeps the admin informed about important marketplace activities in real time.

---

## Admin Notification Overview

- Admin receives notifications for key marketplace actions, including:
  - New orders
  - Order status changes
  - Product creation or updates
  - Product approval requests
  - Vendor-related activities

---

## Notification Area

- All notifications are displayed in the **admin notification area**.
- Notifications help the admin take quick actions without navigating through multiple sections.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-notifications.webp"><img src="./assets/admin-notifications.webp" alt="Admin Notifications" /></a>

---

## Types of Notifications

The admin can view notifications related to:

- **Products**
  - New product added by vendor
  - Product awaiting approval
- **Orders**
  - New order placed
  - Order status updated
- **Vendors**
  - Vendor registration
  - Vendor-related updates

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-notifications-types.webp"><img src="./assets/admin-notifications-types.webp" alt="Admin Notifications Types" /></a>

This system ensures the admin stays updated on all **critical marketplace events** and can manage operations efficiently.

# Customer Order Placement

This guide explains the **customer order placement process** in the WooCommerce Marketplace and highlights how **seller information is displayed** at different stages.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-order-placement.webp"><img src="./assets/customer-order-placement.webp" alt="Customer Order Placement" /></a>

---

## Seller Discovery on Storefront

Before placing an order, customers can identify and choose products from specific sellers.

### Seller Filter on Product Listing Page

- Customers can filter products based on **seller/vendor** on the shop or listing page.
- This helps customers find products from a preferred seller easily.
- Seller-based filtering improves product discovery in a multi-vendor marketplace.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-filter.png"><img src="./assets/vendor-filter.png" alt="seller Filter" /></a>

---

## Seller Information on Product Page

- Each product page displays **seller information** when the product belongs to a vendor.
- Seller details may include:
  - Seller name
  - Seller store link
- Customers can click the seller name to visit the **seller profile page**.

---

## Steps to Place an Order

### 1. Add Product to Cart
- Customer selects the desired product from the storefront.
- Clicks **Add to Cart**.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/add-to-cart.webp"><img src="./assets/add-to-cart.webp" alt="Add to Cart" /></a>

---

### 2. View Cart

- After adding products, the customer can view the **cart page**.
- Seller name is displayed for each product added to the cart.
- Customers can easily identify which seller each product belongs to.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/product-added-cart-block.webp"><img src="./assets/product-added-cart-block.webp" alt="Product Added to Cart" /></a>

---

### 3. Proceed to Checkout

- Click **Proceed to Checkout** to navigate to the checkout page.
- Checkout blocks display:
  - Order summary
  - Billing details
  - Shipping details
- Seller information remains visible for vendor products.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/product-checkout-block.webp"><img src="./assets/product-checkout-block.webp" alt="Checkout Page" /></a>

---

### 4. Order Confirmation

- After successful order placement, the **Order Received** page is displayed.
- Order details include:
  - Ordered products
  - Total amount
  - Shipping information
  - **Seller name for each product**

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/order-received.webp"><img src="./assets/order-received.webp" alt="Order Received" /></a>

---

## Seller Visibility on Order Details Page

- Customers can view seller information from:
  - **My Account → Orders**
  - Order detail page
- Seller name is displayed against each product in the order.
- This ensures transparency in multi-vendor order fulfillment.

---

## Notes

- The order placement process works for both **admin products** and **vendor products**.
- Seller-related information is displayed consistently across:
  - Product listing page
  - Product page
  - Cart page
  - Checkout page
  - Order confirmation and order details page
- This enhances trust and clarity for customers shopping in a multi-vendor marketplace.

- **[Buy Now](https://store.webkul.com/woocommerce-multivendor-marketplace.html)** – Purchase the plugin from the Webkul store.
- **[Marketplace Add-ons](https://store.webkul.com/woocommerce-plugins.html)** – Check out compatible add-ons to enhance your marketplace.

# Get Google Analytics Measurement ID

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/google-analytics-get-started.webp"><img src="./assets/google-analytics-get-started.webp" alt="Google Analytics Get Started" /></a>

This ID helps you track marketplace activity such as visitor traffic, product views, and user interactions, giving you better insights into how your marketplace is performing.
To get the **Google Analytics Measurement ID**, follow these steps:

---

## Steps to Get Google Analytics Measurement ID

1. **Sign in / Get Started**
   - Go to Google Analytics.
   - Click **Sign in to Analytics** or **Get started today**.

2. **Start Measuring**
   - Click **Start measuring**.
   - Enter account details and click **Next**.
   <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/google-analytics-start-measuring.webp"><img src="./assets/google-analytics-start-measuring.webp" alt="Google Analytics Start Measuring" /></a>

3. **Create a Property**
   - Enter **Property name**, **Reporting time zone**, and **Currency**.
   - Click **Next**.
   <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/google-analytics-create-property.webp"><img src="./assets/google-analytics-create-property.webp" alt="Google Analytics Create Property" /></a>

4. **Describe Your Business**
   - Select the option that best describes your business.
   - Click **Next**.
   <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/google-analytics-business-description.webp"><img src="./assets/google-analytics-business-description.webp" alt="Google Analytics Business Description" /></a>

5. **Select Business Objectives**
   - Choose relevant business objectives.
   - Click **Next**.
   <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/google-analytics-business-objectives.webp"><img src="./assets/google-analytics-business-objectives.webp" alt="Google Analytics Business Objectives" /></a>

6. **Accept Terms & Conditions**
   - Read and accept the **Terms & Conditions**.
   <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/google-analytics-terms.webp"><img src="./assets/google-analytics-terms.webp" alt="Google Analytics Terms" /></a>

7. **Choose Platform**
   - Select **Web** as the platform.
   <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/google-analytics-platform-selection.webp"><img src="./assets/google-analytics-platform-selection.webp" alt="Google Analytics Platform Selection" /></a>

8. **Set Up Data Stream**
   - Set up the web stream.
   - Click **Create & Continue**.
   - Click **Next** after creation.
   <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/google-analytics-data-stream.webp"><img src="./assets/google-analytics-data-stream.webp" alt="Google Analytics Data Stream" /></a>

9. **Copy Measurement ID**
   - Copy the **Measurement ID** shown on screen.
   - Paste it into the WooCommerce Marketplace module configuration.
   <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/google-analytics-measurement-id.webp"><img src="./assets/google-analytics-measurement-id.webp" alt="Google Analytics Measurement ID" /></a>

**Note:**
You can add the Google Analytics Measurement ID at a later stage as well, after the marketplace setup and testing are completed. This step is optional during the initial configuration.

[⬅ Back to Google Analytics Configuration](./configuration-google-analytics.html)

# About

This site is the official user documentation for the **WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace** plugin, published and maintained by Webkul Software.

## About the plugin

WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace is a WordPress plugin that converts a standard WooCommerce store into a multi-seller marketplace. It lets independent vendors register, open their own shop pages, list and manage products, process their own orders, track earnings, and request payouts, while the store owner keeps administrative control over vendor approval, commission rates, withdrawal rules, and marketplace-wide settings. It is used to build marketplaces comparable in structure to Amazon, Etsy, Flipkart, or eBay on top of WooCommerce.

The plugin is sold through the [Webkul store](https://store.webkul.com/woocommerce-multivendor-marketplace.html) and a working [live demo](https://wpdemo.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/) is available. A large catalogue of add-ons extends it with payment gateways, shipping methods, tax integrations, mobile apps, point of sale, and vendor management features.

## About Webkul

Webkul Software is an eCommerce software company founded in **2010** by Vipin Sahu, Vinay Yadav, and Prakash Sahu, headquartered in **Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India**. Webkul builds B2B and B2C eCommerce, marketplace, hyperlocal, and mobile application products, and develops extensions for platforms including WooCommerce, Magento, Shopify, Odoo, Bagisto, and UnoPim.

Webkul is a CodeCanyon Featured Author at Author Level 10 and contributes to WooCommerce core. Company details, the full product catalogue, and corporate information are published at [webkul.com](https://webkul.com/).

## About this documentation

These guides cover installation, configuration, vendor workflows, and administrator workflows for the plugin. They are written for store owners setting up a marketplace and for developers integrating it into an existing WooCommerce site.

The documentation is a static site. Every page is also published as raw markdown for AI agents and automated tools — append `.md` to any page URL, or start from [llms.txt](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/llms.txt).

For questions about the plugin, see [Contact](./contact.html). For how this site handles data, see [Privacy](./privacy.html).

# Privacy

This page describes how **this documentation site** (`wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/`) handles data. It does not describe the WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace plugin itself, which runs on your own WordPress installation and stores its data in your own database, under your control.

## What this site collects

This documentation is a **static website**. It has no accounts, no login, no comment system, no contact form, and no newsletter signup. There is nothing on these pages that asks you to submit personal information, and nothing that transmits information about you to Webkul.

**No analytics or advertising trackers are loaded.** These pages do not include Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, advertising pixels, session recording, or any third-party tracking script.

## Browser storage

The site stores exactly one value in your browser's `localStorage`, under the key `vuepress-color-scheme`. It records whether you chose the light or dark theme so your preference survives page navigation. It stays in your browser, is never transmitted anywhere, and you can clear it at any time through your browser's site-data settings. No advertising or identification cookies are set.

## Server logs

The site is served through standard web hosting and content delivery infrastructure. As with any website, those providers process ordinary technical request data — IP address, timestamp, requested URL, user agent, and referrer — for the purpose of delivering pages, caching, and protecting against abuse. Webkul does not use these logs to build a profile of you.

## Links to other sites

These pages link to external sites including the Webkul store, the live demo, the support portal, and CodeCanyon. Once you follow a link, the privacy practices of that destination apply. This page does not cover them.

## Plugin data

If you install the plugin, all marketplace data — vendor accounts, products, orders, commissions, payouts — is created and stored on **your** WordPress site. Webkul does not receive or have access to that data through the plugin. Responsibility for handling your customers' and vendors' personal data under applicable law, including GDPR, rests with you as the site operator.

## Company privacy policy

Webkul Software's corporate privacy policy, covering purchases, support tickets, and other direct interactions with Webkul, is published at [webkul.com/privacy-policy](https://webkul.com/privacy-policy/).

## Questions

Privacy questions about this documentation site or about Webkul's handling of your data can be sent to [support@webkul.com](mailto:support@webkul.com) or raised through the [support portal](https://webkul.uvdesk.com/). Postal address: Webkul Software, H-28, ARV Park, Sector 63, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201301, India.
